textures.method: numpy: palmate 3-5 lobed outline from a soft-max of pointed polar lobes with coarse teeth; primary and secondary veins as distance fields; autumn palette yellow-green to tan and brown with blotch noise and browned margins; 2x supersampled; normal from a dome-plus-vein height map; colour bled under transparent pixels (pull-push) to stop mip fringes. Seed 4101.
numpy: deltoid-ovate outline with acuminate tip and double serration, midrib and seven straight vein pairs; yellow-green to gold palette; clusters on thin dark twigs. Seed 4202.

numpy: two scales of periodic, domain-warped Worley cells; each plate gets a bark age (cream, olive, grey-green, grey-brown); small flakes peel to younger layers; softened rims, rain streaks and algae tint; height from age steps; ORM = cavity AO, roughness by age, metal 0. Tiles both ways, 1 tile = 1 m. Seed 4808.

numpy: cream-white base with grey mottling and pinkish peeled bands; 300 wrapped horizontal lenticel dashes; ragged dark fissured patches from thresholded periodic noise. Black trunk base and dark twigs come from vertex colour (COLOR_0) multiplied in the material. Seed 4909.

numpy: twelve 64 px blade columns (damp dark greens, two yellowed) with keeled midrib, striations, darker base and ragged dried straw tips of random length; two side-view tuft cards drawn as tapered Bezier blades. Seed 4606.
numpy: runcinate dandelion leaves, plantain leaves with parallel veins, a grassy crack weed with seed panicles and a groundsel-type sprig with muted yellow heads. Seed 4707.
numpy: 4 x 4 grid of fallen plane and birch leaves in wet browns, with dark wet spotting, holes, curl in the height map. Seed 4505.
numpy: privet sprigs with opposite small glossy elliptic leaves, an opaque inner-foliage tile (900 overlapping leaves darkened by depth) for the hidden core, small sprig singles. Seed 4404.
numpy: evergreen laurel-type oval leaves with fine serration, a few bronze older leaves, on green twigs. Seed 4303.

materials.all: Principled BSDF; colour images sRGB, normal and ORM Non-Color; OpenGL normals.
materials.alpha: Leaf, grass, weed, hedge and litter materials feed image alpha through a Math Round node (alpha clip at 0.5) and have backface culling off, so glTF exports alphaMode MASK, doubleSided.
materials.bark: hr_bark_plane and hr_bark_birch multiply the base colour by the Col vertex colour attribute (glTF COLOR_0). Occlusion via the glTF Material Output group from the ORM red channel.
materials.normals: Leaf cards carry custom normals blended towards the canopy radial direction so crowns light softly; grass normals lean towards +Z so lawns light like the ground.

provenance: Original ONSITE deterministic tree generators and existing project procedural bark/leaf textures. No external meshes.
